title: cloudflare/quiche
title_zh: 开源项目 quiche: QUIC传输协议和HTTP/3的开源实现

paragraphs.en: 🥧 Savoury implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and HTTP/3
paragraphs.zh: 🥧 QUIC 传输协议与 HTTP/3 的美味实现

paragraphs.en: quiche is an implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and HTTP/3 as specified by the IETF . It provides a low level API for processing QUIC packets and handling connection state. The application is responsible for providing I/O (e.g. sockets handling) as well as an event loop with support for timers.
paragraphs.zh: quiche 是 IETF 规定的 QUIC 传输协议和 HTTP/3 的一个实现。 它提供了一个低级别 API，用于处理 QUIC 数据包和管理连接状态。 应用程序负责提供 I/O（例如套接字处理）以及支持定时器的事件循环。

sents.en: quiche is an implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and HTTP/3 as specified by the IETF .
sents.zh: quiche 是 IETF 规定的 QUIC 传输协议和 HTTP/3 的一个实现。

sents.en: It provides a low level API for processing QUIC packets and handling connection state.
sents.zh: 它提供了一个低级别 API，用于处理 QUIC 数据包和管理连接状态。

sents.en: The application is responsible for providing I/O (e.g. sockets handling) as well as an event loop with support for timers.
sents.zh: 应用程序负责提供 I/O（例如套接字处理）以及支持定时器的事件循环。

paragraphs.en: For more information on how quiche came about and some insights into its design you can read a post on Cloudflare's blog that goes into some more detail.
paragraphs.zh: 有关 quiche 的由来及其设计的一些见解，您可以阅读 Cloudflare 博客上的一篇文章，其中进行了更详细的介绍。

paragraphs.en: quiche powers Cloudflare edge network's HTTP/3 support . The cloudflare-quic.com website can be used for testing and experimentation.
paragraphs.zh: quiche 为 Cloudflare 边缘网络的 HTTP/3 支持提供动力。 cloudflare-quic.com 网站可用于测试与实验。

sents.en: quiche powers Cloudflare edge network's HTTP/3 support .

sents.en: The cloudflare-quic.com website can be used for testing and experimentation.
sents.zh: cloudflare-quic.com 网站可用于测试与实验。

paragraphs.en: Android's DNS resolver uses quiche to implement DNS over HTTP/3 .
paragraphs.zh: Android 的 DNS 解析器使用 quiche 来实现基于 HTTP/3 的 DNS。

paragraphs.en: quiche can be integrated into curl to provide support for HTTP/3.
paragraphs.zh: quiche 可以集成到 curl 中，以提供对 HTTP/3 的支持。

paragraphs.en: Before diving into the quiche API, here are a few examples on how to use the quiche tools provided as part of the quiche-apps crate. These are not suitable for production environments; see disclaimers and notes .
paragraphs.zh: 在深入了解 quiche API 之前，这里有几个关于如何使用 quiche-apps crate 中提供的 quiche 工具的示例。 这些工具并不适用于生产环境；请参阅免责声明和说明。

sents.en: Before diving into the quiche API, here are a few examples on how to use the quiche tools provided as part of the quiche-apps crate.
sents.zh: 在深入了解 quiche API 之前，这里有几个关于如何使用 quiche-apps crate 中提供的 quiche 工具的示例。

paragraphs.en: After cloning the project according to the command mentioned in the building section, the client can be run as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 按照构建部分中提到的命令克隆项目后，可以按如下方式运行客户端：

paragraphs.en: $ cargo run --bin quiche-client -- https://cloudflare-quic.com/ while the server can be run as follows:
paragraphs.zh:
```
$ cargo run --bin quiche-client -- https://cloudflare-quic.com/
```
而服务器可以这样运行：

paragraphs.en: $ cargo run --bin quiche-server -- --cert apps/src/bin/cert.crt --key apps/src/bin/cert.key (note that the certificate provided is self-signed and should not be used in production)
paragraphs.zh: $ cargo run --bin quiche-server -- --cert apps/src/bin/cert.crt --key apps/src/bin/cert.key（注意：所提供的证书是自签名的，不应用于生产环境）

paragraphs.en: Use the --help command-line flag to get a more detailed description of each tool's options.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 --help 命令行标志可获取每个工具选项的更详细描述。

paragraphs.en: The first step in establishing a QUIC connection using quiche is creating a Config object:
paragraphs.zh: 使用 quiche 建立 QUIC 连接的第一步是创建 Config 对象：

paragraphs.en: let mut config = quiche :: Config :: new ( quiche :: PROTOCOL_VERSION ) ? ; config . set_application_protos ( & [ b"example-proto" ] ) ; // Additional configuration specific to application and use case... The Config object controls important aspects of the QUIC connection such as QUIC version, ALPN IDs, flow control, congestion control, idle timeout and other properties or features.
paragraphs.zh: let mut config = quiche :: Config :: new ( quiche :: PROTOCOL_VERSION ) ? ; config . set_application_protos ( & [ b"example-proto" ] ) ; // 针对应用和用例的额外配置... Config 对象控制 QUIC 连接的重要方面，例如 QUIC 版本、ALPN 标识符、流量控制、拥塞控制、空闲超时以及其他属性或特性。

sents.en: let mut config = quiche :: Config :: new ( quiche :: PROTOCOL_VERSION ) ? ; config . set_application_protos ( & [ b"example-proto" ] ) ; // Additional configuration specific to application and use case...
sents.zh: let mut config = quiche :: Config :: new ( quiche :: PROTOCOL_VERSION ) ? ; config . set_application_protos ( & [ b"example-proto" ] ) ; // 针对应用和用例的额外配置...

sents.en: The Config object controls important aspects of the QUIC connection such as QUIC version, ALPN IDs, flow control, congestion control, idle timeout and other properties or features.
sents.zh: Config 对象控制 QUIC 连接的重要方面，例如 QUIC 版本、ALPN 标识符、流量控制、拥塞控制、空闲超时以及其他属性或特性。

paragraphs.en: QUIC is a general-purpose transport protocol and there are several configuration properties where there is no reasonable default value. For example, the permitted number of concurrent streams of any particular type is dependent on the application running over QUIC, and other use-case specific concerns.
paragraphs.zh: QUIC 是一种通用传输协议，存在若干没有合理默认值的配置属性。 例如，任一特定类型所允许的并发流数量取决于运行在 QUIC 之上的应用程序以及其他用例特定的考量。

sents.en: QUIC is a general-purpose transport protocol and there are several configuration properties where there is no reasonable default value.
sents.zh: QUIC 是一种通用传输协议，存在若干没有合理默认值的配置属性。

sents.en: For example, the permitted number of concurrent streams of any particular type is dependent on the application running over QUIC, and other use-case specific concerns.
sents.zh: 例如，任一特定类型所允许的并发流数量取决于运行在 QUIC 之上的应用程序以及其他用例特定的考量。

paragraphs.en: quiche defaults several properties to zero, applications most likely need to set these to something else to satisfy their needs using the following:
paragraphs.zh: quiche 将若干属性默认设置为零，应用程序很可能需要使用以下方法将其设置为其他值以满足自身需求：

paragraphs.en: Config also holds TLS configuration. This can be changed by mutators on the an existing object, or by constructing a TLS context manually and creating a configuration using with_boring_ssl_ctx_builder() .
paragraphs.zh: 配置中还包含 TLS 配置。 这可以通过对现有对象使用变更器（mutators）来修改，也可以手动构建 TLS 上下文并使用 with_boring_ssl_ctx_builder() 创建配置。

sents.en: Config also holds TLS configuration.
sents.zh: 配置中还包含 TLS 配置。

sents.en: This can be changed by mutators on the an existing object, or by constructing a TLS context manually and creating a configuration using with_boring_ssl_ctx_builder() .
sents.zh: 这可以通过对现有对象使用变更器（mutators）来修改，也可以手动构建 TLS 上下文并使用 with_boring_ssl_ctx_builder() 创建配置。

paragraphs.en: A configuration object can be shared among multiple connections.
paragraphs.zh: 一个配置对象可以在多个连接之间共享。

paragraphs.en: On the client-side the connect() utility function can be used to create a new connection, while accept() is for servers:
paragraphs.zh: 在客户端，可以使用 connect() 工具函数来创建新的连接，而服务器端则使用 accept()：

paragraphs.en: // Client connection. let conn = quiche :: connect ( Some ( & server_name ) , & scid , local , peer , & mut config ) ? ; // Server connection. let conn = quiche :: accept ( & scid , None , local , peer , & mut config ) ? ; Handling incoming packets Using the connection's recv() method the application can process incoming packets that belong to that connection from the network:
paragraphs.zh: // 客户端连接。 let conn = quiche :: connect ( Some ( & server_name ) , & scid , local , peer , & mut config ) ? ; // 服务器连接。 let conn = quiche :: accept ( & scid , None , local , peer , & mut config ) ? ; 处理传入的数据包 使用连接的 recv() 方法，应用程序可以从网络中处理属于该连接的传入数据包：

paragraphs.en: let to = socket . local_addr ( ) . unwrap ( ) ; loop { let ( read , from ) = socket . recv_from ( & mut buf ) . unwrap ( ) ; let recv_info = quiche :: RecvInfo { from , to } ; let read = match conn . recv ( & mut buf [ ..read ] , recv_info ) { Ok ( v ) => v , Err ( e ) => { // An error occurred, handle it. break ; } , } ; } Generating outgoing packets Outgoing packet are generated using the connection's send() method instead:

loop { let ( write , send_info ) = match conn . send ( & mut out ) { Ok ( v ) => v , Err ( quiche :: Error :: Done ) => { // Done writing. break ; } , Err ( e ) => { // An error occurred, handle it. break ; } , } ; socket . send_to ( & out [ ..write ] , & send_info . to ) . unwrap ( ) ; } When packets are sent, the application is responsible for maintaining a timer to react to time-based connection events. The timer expiration can be obtained using the connection's timeout() method.
paragraphs.zh: loop { let ( write , send_info ) = match conn . send ( & mut out ) { Ok ( v ) => v , Err ( quiche :: Error :: Done ) => { // 写入完成。 break ; } , Err ( e ) => { // 发生了错误，处理它。 break ; } , } ; socket . send_to ( & out [ ..write ] , & send_info . to ) . unwrap ( ) ; } 在发送数据包时，应用程序负责维护一个定时器，以响应基于时间的连接事件。 定时器的过期时间可以通过连接的 timeout() 方法获取。

sents.en: loop { let ( write , send_info ) = match conn . send ( & mut out ) { Ok ( v ) => v , Err ( quiche :: Error :: Done ) => { // Done writing. break ; } , Err ( e ) => { // An error occurred, handle it. break ; } , } ; socket . send_to ( & out [ ..write ] , & send_info . to ) . unwrap ( ) ; } When packets are sent, the application is responsible for maintaining a timer to react to time-based connection events.
sents.zh: loop { let ( write , send_info ) = match conn . send ( & mut out ) { Ok ( v ) => v , Err ( quiche :: Error :: Done ) => { // 写入完成。 break ; } , Err ( e ) => { // 发生了错误，处理它。 break ; } , } ; socket . send_to ( & out [ ..write ] , & send_info . to ) . unwrap ( ) ; } 在发送数据包时，应用程序负责维护一个定时器，以响应基于时间的连接事件。

sents.en: The timer expiration can be obtained using the connection's timeout() method.
sents.zh: 定时器的过期时间可以通过连接的 timeout() 方法获取。

paragraphs.en: let timeout = conn . timeout ( ) ; The application is responsible for providing a timer implementation, which can be specific to the operating system or networking framework used. When a timer expires, the connection's on_timeout() method should be called, after which additional packets might need to be sent on the network:
paragraphs.zh: let timeout = conn . timeout ( ) ; 应用程序负责提供定时器实现，可以是所使用的操作系统或网络框架特定的实现。 当定时器到期时，应调用该连接的 on_timeout() 方法，之后可能还需要在网络上发送额外的数据包：

sents.en: let timeout = conn . timeout ( ) ; The application is responsible for providing a timer implementation, which can be specific to the operating system or networking framework used.
sents.zh: let timeout = conn . timeout ( ) ; 应用程序负责提供定时器实现，可以是所使用的操作系统或网络框架特定的实现。

sents.en: When a timer expires, the connection's on_timeout() method should be called, after which additional packets might need to be sent on the network:
sents.zh: 当定时器到期时，应调用该连接的 on_timeout() 方法，之后可能还需要在网络上发送额外的数据包：

paragraphs.en: // Timeout expired, handle it. conn . on_timeout ( ) ; // Send more packets as needed after timeout. loop { let ( write , send_info ) = match conn . send ( & mut out ) { Ok ( v ) => v , Err ( quiche :: Error :: Done ) => { // Done writing. break ; } , Err ( e ) => { // An error occurred, handle it. break ; } , } ; socket . send_to ( & out [ ..write ] , & send_info . to ) . unwrap ( ) ; } Pacing It is recommended that applications pace sending of outgoing packets to avoid creating packet bursts that could cause short-term congestion and losses in the network.
paragraphs.zh: // 超时已过期，进行处理。conn . on_timeout ( ) ; // 超时后根据需要发送更多数据包。loop { let ( write , send_info ) = match conn . send ( & mut out ) { Ok ( v ) => v , Err ( quiche :: Error :: Done ) => { // 写入完成。break ; } , Err ( e ) => { // 发生错误，进行处理。break ; } , } ; socket . send_to ( & out [ ..write ] , & send_info . to ) . unwrap ( ) ; } 步调控制（Pacing） 建议应用程序对传出数据包的发送进行步调控制，以避免产生可能导致网络中出现短期拥塞和丢包的数据包突发。

paragraphs.en: quiche exposes pacing hints for outgoing packets through the [ at ] field of the [ SendInfo ] structure that is returned by the send() method. This field represents the time when a specific packet should be sent into the network.
paragraphs.zh: quiche 通过 send() 方法返回的 [ SendInfo ] 结构中的 [ at ] 字段，为传出数据包暴露发送时机提示。 该字段表示特定数据包应被发送到网络中的时间。

sents.en: quiche exposes pacing hints for outgoing packets through the [ at ] field of the [ SendInfo ] structure that is returned by the send() method.
sents.zh: quiche 通过 send() 方法返回的 [ SendInfo ] 结构中的 [ at ] 字段，为传出数据包暴露发送时机提示。

sents.en: This field represents the time when a specific packet should be sent into the network.
sents.zh: 该字段表示特定数据包应被发送到网络中的时间。

paragraphs.en: Applications can use these hints by artificially delaying the sending of packets through platform-specific mechanisms (such as the SO_TXTIME socket option on Linux), or custom methods (for example by using user-space timers).
paragraphs.zh: 应用程序可以通过平台特定的机制（例如 Linux 上的 SO_TXTIME 套接字选项）或自定义方法（例如使用用户态定时器）人为地延迟数据包的发送，从而利用这些提示。

paragraphs.en: After some back and forth, the connection will complete its handshake and will be ready for sending or receiving application data.
paragraphs.zh: 经过几次来回交互后，连接将完成其握手过程，并准备好发送或接收应用数据。

paragraphs.en: Data can be sent on a stream by using the stream_send() method:
paragraphs.zh: 可以通过 stream_send() 方法在流上发送数据：

paragraphs.en: if conn . is_established ( ) { // Handshake completed, send some data on stream 0. conn . stream_send ( 0 , b"hello" , true ) ? ; } The application can check whether there are any readable streams by using the connection's readable() method, which returns an iterator over all the streams that have outstanding data to read.
paragraphs.zh: 如果 conn . is_established ( ) { // 握手已完成，在流 0 上发送一些数据。 conn . stream_send ( 0 , b"hello" , true ) ? ; } 应用程序可以通过连接的 readable() 方法检查是否存在任何可读的流，该方法返回一个迭代器，遍历所有有待读取数据的流。

paragraphs.en: The stream_recv() method can then be used to retrieve the application data from the readable stream:
paragraphs.zh: stream_recv() 方法随后可用于从可读流中检索应用数据：

paragraphs.en: if conn . is_established ( ) { // Iterate over readable streams. for stream_id in conn . readable ( ) { // Stream is readable, read until there's no more data. while let Ok ( ( read , fin ) ) = conn . stream_recv ( stream_id , & mut buf ) { println ! ( "Got {} bytes on stream {}" , read , stream_id ) ; } } } HTTP/3 The quiche HTTP/3 module provides a high level API for sending and receiving HTTP requests and responses on top of the QUIC transport protocol.

paragraphs.en: Have a look at the [quiche/examples/] directory for more complete examples on how to use the quiche API, including examples on how to use quiche in C/C++ applications (see below for more information).
paragraphs.zh: 请查看 [quiche/examples/] 目录，以获取有关如何使用 quiche API 的更完整示例，包括如何在 C/C++ 应用程序中使用 quiche 的示例（更多信息请见下文）。

paragraphs.en: quiche exposes a thin C API on top of the Rust API that can be used to more easily integrate quiche into C/C++ applications (as well as in other languages that allow calling C APIs via some form of FFI). The C API follows the same design of the Rust one, modulo the constraints imposed by the C language itself.
paragraphs.zh: quiche 在 Rust API 之上提供了一个轻量的 C API，可用于更轻松地将 quiche 集成到 C/C++ 应用程序中（以及允许通过某种形式的 FFI 调用 C API 的其他语言）。 该 C API 遵循与 Rust API 相同的设计，只是受 C 语言自身约束的限制。

paragraphs.en: When running cargo build , a static library called libquiche.a will be built automatically alongside the Rust one. This is fully stand-alone and can be linked directly into C/C++ applications.
paragraphs.zh: 运行 cargo build 时，会自动生成一个名为 libquiche.a 的静态库，与 Rust 库一起构建。 它是完全独立的，可以直接链接到 C/C++ 应用程序中。

sents.en: This is fully stand-alone and can be linked directly into C/C++ applications.
sents.zh: 它是完全独立的，可以直接链接到 C/C++ 应用程序中。

paragraphs.en: Note that in order to enable the FFI API, the ffi feature must be enabled (it is disabled by default), by passing --features ffi to cargo .
paragraphs.zh: 注意，为了启用 FFI API，必须启用 ffi 特性（默认情况下是禁用的），方法是将 --features ffi 传递给 cargo。

paragraphs.zh: quiche 构建 requires…— 更正：quiche 构建需要 Rust 1.88 或更高版本。 可以使用 rustup 安装最新的稳定版 Rust。

paragraphs.en: Once the Rust build environment is setup, the quiche source code can be fetched using git:
paragraphs.zh: Rust 构建环境设置完成后，可以使用 git 获取 quiche 源代码：

paragraphs.en: $ git clone https://github.com/cloudflare/quiche and then built using cargo:
paragraphs.zh: $ git clone https://github.com/cloudflare/quiche 然后使用 cargo 进行构建：

paragraphs.en: $ cargo build --examples cargo can also be used to run the testsuite:
paragraphs.zh: $ cargo build --examples 也可以使用 cargo 来运行测试套件：

paragraphs.en: $ cargo test Note that BoringSSL , which is used to implement QUIC's cryptographic handshake based on TLS, needs to be built and linked to quiche. This is done automatically by the boring-sys crate when building with cargo, but requires the cmake command to be available during the build process.
paragraphs.zh: $ cargo test 请注意，BoringSSL（用于实现基于 TLS 的 QUIC 加密握手）需要被构建并链接到 quiche。 在使用 cargo 构建时，boring-sys crate 会自动完成这项工作，但要求在构建过程中可以使用 cmake 命令。

paragraphs.zh: 或者，您也可以通过 BORING_BSSL_PATH 环境变量配置 BoringSSL 目录，从而使用您自己构建的自定义版 BoringSSL：

paragraphs.en: $ BORING_BSSL_PATH= " /path/to/boringssl " cargo build --examples Building for Android Building quiche for Android (NDK version 19 or higher, 21 recommended), can be done using cargo-ndk (v2.0 or later).

$ BORING_BSSL_PATH="/path/to/boringssl" cargo build --examples

针对 Android 构建

构建适用于 Android 的 quiche（需要 NDK 版本 19 或更高，推荐 21），可以使用 cargo-ndk（v2.0 或更高版本）来完成。

paragraphs.en: First the Android NDK needs to be installed, either using Android Studio or directly, and the ANDROID_NDK_HOME environment variable needs to be set to the NDK installation path, e.g.:
paragraphs.zh: 首先需要安装 Android NDK，可以通过 Android Studio 或直接下载安装，并且需要将 ANDROID_NDK_HOME 环境变量设置为 NDK 的安装路径，例如：

paragraphs.en: $ export ANDROID_NDK_HOME=/usr/local/share/android-ndk Then the Rust toolchain for the Android architectures needed can be installed as follows:
paragraphs.zh: $ export ANDROID_NDK_HOME=/usr/local/share/android-ndk 然后可以按照如下方式安装所需的 Android 架构的 Rust 工具链：

paragraphs.en: $ rustup target add aarch64-linux-android armv7-linux-androideabi i686-linux-android x86_64-linux-android Note that the minimum API level is 21 for all target architectures.
paragraphs.zh: $ rustup target add aarch64-linux-android armv7-linux-androideabi i686-linux-android x86_64-linux-android 请注意，所有目标架构的最低 API 级别均为 21。

paragraphs.en: cargo-ndk (v2.0 or later) also needs to be installed:
paragraphs.zh: 还需要安装 cargo-ndk（v2.0 或更高版本）：

paragraphs.en: $ cargo install cargo-ndk Finally the quiche library can be built using the following procedure. Note that the -t <architecture> and -p <NDK version> options are mandatory.
paragraphs.zh: $ cargo install cargo-ndk 最后，可以使用以下步骤构建 quiche 库。 请注意，-t <architecture> 和 -p <NDK version> 选项是必填的。

sents.en: $ cargo install cargo-ndk Finally the quiche library can be built using the following procedure.
sents.zh: $ cargo install cargo-ndk 最后，可以使用以下步骤构建 quiche 库。

sents.en: Note that the -t <architecture> and -p <NDK version> options are mandatory.
sents.zh: 请注意，-t <architecture> 和 -p <NDK version> 选项是必填的。

paragraphs.en: $ cargo ndk -t arm64-v8a -p 21 -- build --features ffi See build_android_ndk19.sh for more information.
paragraphs.zh: $ cargo ndk -t arm64-v8a -p 21 -- build --features ffi 更多信息请参见 build_android_ndk19.sh。

paragraphs.en: To build quiche for iOS, you need the following:
paragraphs.zh: 要为 iOS 构建 quiche，你需要以下内容：

paragraphs.en: $ xcode-select --install Install the Rust toolchain for iOS architectures: $ rustup target add aarch64-apple-ios x86_64-apple-ios Install cargo-lipo : $ cargo install cargo-lipo To build libquiche, run the following command:
paragraphs.zh: $ xcode-select --install 安装适用于 iOS 架构的 Rust 工具链： $ rustup target add aarch64-apple-ios x86_64-apple-ios 安装 cargo-lipo ： $ cargo install cargo-lipo 要构建 libquiche，请运行以下命令：

paragraphs.en: $ cargo lipo --features ffi --release iOS build is tested in Xcode 10.1 and Xcode 11.2.
paragraphs.zh:
```bash
$ cargo lipo --features ffi --release
```
iOS 构建已在 Xcode 10.1 和 Xcode 11.2 中测试。
